title: Qin's quasimodularity conjecture for Hilbert schemes of points
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth projective complex surface with numerically trivial canonical class. With the help of GPT-5.6 Sol, we prove Qin's conjecture that the reduced generating series of intersection numbers of Chern characters of tautological bundles against the total Chern class of $X^{[n]}$ is a quasimodular form with the predicted mixed-weight bound. The main ingredient is a Wick's theorem-type formula for computing traces of normally ordered products of Nakajima operators on $\bigoplus_n H^*(X^{[n]})$.
